scope: Read-only review and independent host execution of the frozen original five-model composition tests. No production ownership enforcement, physical allocation, hardware, firmware execution, kernel build or packet admission.

additional_independent_probes.name: existing_plus4_ring_label
additional_independent_probes.meaning: The +4 label is four-byte aligned and accepted by bcr_open; rejection is the composition correspondence assertion, not an alignment failure.

additional_independent_probes.name: plus_one_DART_page_ring_label
additional_independent_probes.meaning: A separately aligned label in an unmapped page also fails the composition assertion. No predecessor code was modified.

findings.finding: Actual five model implementations and unchanged DART codec are linked. Fake register callbacks operate on ordinary test arrays; compiled-out shared APCIE PHY/PMGR paths remain disabled. Test-only preflight refuses PHY 0x80 before endpoint/model binding.

One static fixture owns one map, IRQ source and ring; duplicate prepare is tested before and after finish, with no extra callbacks. The lost-owner mutant is now observed after finish. This is an assertion about the test orchestrator, not a production registry, generation lease, cross-object uniqueness or concurrency mechanism.

The actual codec validates the requested synthetic RID/SID READ translation; wrong SID and WRITE are refused without changing PA output. Descriptor label equality connects ring metadata to that IOVA. F.buffer is independent ordinary RAM: no PA-to-CPU backing, DMA reachability, coherence, or MSI address authorization is established.

Reset after producer publication retains dirty/faulted/inflight ring, blocks retry and prevents bell; pending IRQ blocks close. Fault episodes stop and keep owner set without declaring complete. Fresh resets the fixture between test cases only; it is not tested or admitted as recovery/reclamation.

282 positions are read_fake/write_fake callbacks in fresh(0), each run with apply_failed_write 0 and 1. The two runs duplicate read failures; only write failures distinguish before/after application. request_fake firmware metadata callbacks are not fail-at injected, and DAR=1 has a healthy test rather than the 282-position fault sweep. Six mutations alter the test orchestrator, not predecessor implementations. No exhaustive fault coverage claim is admitted.

Consumer advancement is an explicit ordinary-RAM test write and IRQ receive is explicitly injected. Successful close retains owner, DART pages and backing. Transport remains BCT_SHARED; mailbox setup/post phase is excluded. No actual device completion, drain, release or real interrupt routing follows.

caller_constraints_for_future_compositio: Serialized sole owner must hold all model objects, storage, IO context and policy spans for the full unresolved lifetime.
Cross-object RID/SID/vector exclusivity and stable nonaliasing backing remain external obligations.
Do not reuse or free retained state on failures merely because the next test resets F; no real quiescence or unmap/release exists.
A future backing provider must independently bind ring CPU storage to a validated physical mapping; pa_checked is not ownership authorization.
Keep actual PHY/power/link, firmware identity and hardware interrupt admission separate from this fixture.

required_six_checks.scope: Existing root execution receipt hash reverified; not independently rerun for this read-only focused review.
